correctness.evidence: Recompiled/replayed C enumerator: bit-identical T5 7579/94 and M6 7741776/362 tables; verifier confirms T5 independent Python recount, 456 witnesses, symmetries, marginals, exact chain-cover widths.

originality.evidence: OEIS Dedekind totals and size-only counts plus prior interval method do not give the joint rank-profile tables; Sperner widths alone are standard.

scientific_value.evidence: Exact joint tables for natural truncated/middle Boolean lattices expose cross-rank information and serve as bounded benchmark, without a larger-n theorem.

limitations: M6 has no independently designed second full enumerator; checked replay and witness/marginal properties
